propositions: The close gate permits duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated closes only when a live replacement link is named, but fails to tell operators what link action fixes the gate.

When _has_live_replacement_link returns False for a duplicate close, the gate falls through to the LLM completion verifier, which synthesizes a false-positive resolution message and offers only impossible remediation paths.
The gate must hard-fail a --class duplicate close with no recorded duplicates link, raising CommandError that names the exact rebar link command needed to unblock it.
The link existence check must accept a closed target canonical, since closing a duplicate of an already-closed canonical is the common case.
A duplicate close naming an archived or unresolvable target must produce a distinct error message from a close naming no link at all.
